verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships as a git repo/marketplace plugin (obra/superpowers-marketplace) installable via `/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace` and `/plugin install superpowers@...`, with skills stored as harness-agnostic files in `skills/` that are the shared source of truth across Claude Code, Codex, Devin, Hermes, Gemini CLI, etc., making it straightforward for a lead to distribute a standard skill set via marketplace, shared repo, or committed files. missing for 10: no independent case study of a team actually standardizing on it, and community commentary (superpowers-comm-4) flags the install mechanism as an odd curl|bash-like flow rather than a polished enterprise distribution story.
